verify.title: Confirm it's you
verify.lead: The admin panel asks for your passkey every 15 minutes. Your device will ask for your PIN, fingerprint or face.
verify.failed: The passkey could not be confirmed. Try again.

no_passkey.title: You need a passkey
no_passkey.body: To use the panel, add a passkey to your account in settings.

errors.admin_verification_required: Confirm with your passkey to continue.
errors.passkey_verification_failed: The passkey could not be confirmed. Try again.
errors.is_guest: This is a guest account: it has no email to change.
errors.cannot_target_self: You can't do this to your own account. Use the app's settings, or ask another admin.
errors.email_taken: Another account already has that email.
errors.sign_in_not_allowed: That address can't sign in yet. Add it to the sign-in allowlist (SIGN_IN_ALLOWLIST) first.

home.title: Admin
home.error: The figures could not be loaded.

chart.title: Sign-ups per week
chart.subtitle: The last 12 weeks, Monday to Sunday (UTC).

lookup.title: Look up an account
lookup.label: Account email or id
lookup.miss: No account with that email or id

account.title: Account
account.error: The account could not be loaded.
account.own: This is your own account: you can't delete or suspend it from here.

sheet.reason_hint: No personal data here. It stays in the audit log.
sheet.confirm_mismatch: The confirmation doesn't match the account.
sheet.confirm_label: To confirm, type the account's email
sheet.confirm_label_guest: To confirm, type the account's id

change_email.title: Change the email
change_email.lead: We'll send a link to the new email. The change happens when the person opens it, within 24 hours.

sign_out.title: Sign out everywhere
sign_out.lead: Every session ends, on every device.

suspend.title: Suspend the account
suspend.lead: Its sessions end, its assistants are disconnected, and it can't sign in until you reactivate it.

reactivate.title: Reactivate the account
reactivate.lead: The person can sign in again as usual.

delete.title: Delete the account
delete.lead: The account and all its data go at once. Backups that hold it age out within 14 days.

assistant.title: Disconnect {name}
assistant.lead: The assistant loses access to the account.

passkey.title: Remove {name}
passkey.lead: It can no longer be used to sign in.
